content_value: Between Biaxial and Uniaxial Geogrid and Cellular Confinement Technologies, Geosynthetics Have Been at the Forefront of Soil Stabilization Applications Since 1959.

BaseLok offers a full range of proven high-performance Biaxial (BX) and Triaxial (BT) geogrids for subgrade stabilization and pavement optimization. Our complete line gives the engineering community a dependable, cost-effective alternative to overpriced geosynthetic options on the market — with Biaxial grids delivering bidirectional strength for base reinforcement and subgrade stabilization, and Triaxial grids providing multi-directional stiffness for maximum aggregate confinement and load distribution..

Every BaseLok design is backed by strict quality control testing and extensive University and third party testing, which supports our professional engineered designs and powers BaseLok Pro software — so you can be assured our designs are dependable and accurate. Our team of professional engineers is always ready to help with alternative designs, problematic projects, or cost optimization.

• Bridges Weak Subgrades: Spans unstable, low-strength soils to create a stable working platform.
  • Extends Pavement Life: Increases load distribution and eliminates rutting over the pavement lifecycle.
  • Reduces Material Costs: Optimizes aggregate thickness, lowering excavation and haul-in volumes.
  • Eliminates Chemical Stabilization: Removes the cost and complexity of lime or cement treatment.
  • Proven Performance: High tensile strength and rigid design deliver reliable field results.

100% US Sourced & Manufactured
 60+ Years Proven Technology

• Fast Install : Lightweight rolls deploy quickly to cover large areas and speed construction.
  • High Strength :  Rigid ribs and reinforced junctions deliver dependable in-ground performance.

• 1. BASE STABLIZATION : Bridges over weak, saturated, or variable subgrades, providing an expedient construction technique for access roads and working platforms over soft ground.
  • 2. aggregate base REINFORCEMENT : Can be filled with angular rock, concrete or with vegetated soil to confine the infill material, creating a stable layer protecting the slope from erosion.
  • 3. flexible pavement reinforcement : Used for both cut and fill applications on retaining walls. The flexible panels are custom made to the dimensions required by the project engineer.
  • 4. heavy -duty & working surfaces :  Supports haul roads, laydown yards, crane pads, and industrial surfaces subject to heavy, repeated, or dynamic loads.

There is a growing demand for infrastructure solutions that are not only cost-effective and fast to deploy but also sustainable and adaptable to challenging ground conditions. At Baselok, we are dedicated to delivering advanced geosynthetic solutions that meet these evolving construction requirements.

Baselok FabGrid is a high-performance geotextile-based reinforcement solution designed to provide superior separation, filtration, and stabilization. Manufactured using advanced fabric technology, it effectively prevents the mixing of subgrade soil with aggregate layers while maintaining excellent drainage characteristics. Compared to conventional ground improvement methods, Baselok FabGrid offers enhanced durability, improved load distribution, and long-term performance even in weak soil conditions. 

Its flexible structure allows it to adapt to varying terrains, making it highly effective across a wide range of soil types and site conditions. Designed for applications such as roads, railways, embankments, drainage systems, and working platforms, Baselok FabGrid enhances structural integrity while reducing settlement and maintenance requirements. 

It also helps optimize material usage, resulting in cost savings and reduced environmental impact. With proven reliability across infrastructure, industrial, and transportation projects, Baselok FabGrid provides an efficient and sustainable solution—ensuring improved ground performance, extended service life, and consistent results in demanding environments.
